whisper-mode.tooltip: Choose OpenAI API, any server with an OpenAI-compatible API (e.g., your own inference hub) or a local Whisper server

openai-api-key.tooltip: Your OpenAI API key for Whisper (required if using OpenAI mode)

openai-model.tooltip: Whisper-1: Standard speech-to-text. GPT-4o Transcribe: Latest model with best accuracy for all languages

local-url.tooltip: URL of your local Whisper server (e.g., faster-whisper-server)

compat-base-url.tooltip: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API, usually ending with /v1 (e.g., https://hub.example.com/v1)

compat-api-key.tooltip: API key for the server. Leave empty if the server does not require authentication

compat-model.tooltip: Model name exactly as the server knows it. Use 'Check Connection' to pick it from the server's list

compat-check-connection.description: Check Connection and Choose Transcription Model...
compat-check-connection.tooltip: Connect to the server, show the list of available models and pick one with a click

recording-duration.tooltip: Safety limit for maximum recording duration. Recording will automatically stop and transcribe when this limit is reached. Default: 5 minutes (300 seconds).

script-path.tooltip: Full path to the voice input script

chat-model.tooltip: Model for processing text with custom prompts

compat-chat-model.tooltip: Chat model on the server for processing recognized text with custom prompts

compat-choose-chat-model.tooltip: Connect to the server, show the list of available models and pick the chat model for custom prompts with a click

compat-enable-thinking.description: Allow reasoning (thinking) of the chat model
compat-enable-thinking.tooltip: Off (recommended): reasoning models (Qwen3 and similar) answer many times faster, the request carries chat_template_kwargs: {"enable_thinking": false}, supported by vLLM and SGLang. On: the model decides itself and the field is not sent; also turn it on if the server rejects prompt requests

custom-prompts-help.description: Instructions: Click '+' to add. Use AI to process text. Example: Name='Fix Grammar', Prompt='Correct all typos in the following text:'

custom-prompts.description: Custom Prompts: click '+' to add. Use AI to process recognized text.
custom-prompts.tooltip: Enabled: toggle prompt. Menu Name: how it appears in right-click menu. System Prompt: instructions for the AI (e.g., 'Translate to French' or 'Fix grammar').

export-to-file.tooltip: Save all settings to a JSON file

export-to-clipboard.tooltip: Copy all settings to clipboard as JSON

import-from-file.tooltip: Load settings from a JSON file
